alt.zh: 朱红色唱片封套、同心唱纹与米色纸标签

body.en: A listening room for the notes tucked inside record sleeves.
body.zh: 带一张唱片来，听听封套里那张纸写了什么

notes.zh: 介绍这场虚构的小型试听会

title.zh:
放唱片前
先读一页

body.en: Pass the sleeve around the table. A name, a date or a handwritten dedication becomes the introduction to the first track.
body.zh: 把封套传给坐在旁边的人，找找内页有没有人名、日期或手写题词

notes.en: Give everyone time to look at the sleeve.
notes.zh: 留一点时间给大家传看封套

body.en: One table keeps the conversation within reach of the turntable.
body.zh: 大家围着一张长桌坐，唱机放在伸手够得到的一头

notes.zh: 说说座位和唱机怎么摆

body.en: Choose a record with a note worth reading aloud.
body.zh: 挑一张封套里有字的唱片，下次见面念其中一行

notes.en: Invite participants to choose a record.
notes.zh: 请听众想一想，自己架子上哪张最合适
